# Purrtocol Entropy Reactor

> Deterministic breeder diversity diagnostic. Concept-space cardinality is kept separate from real indexed lineage.

Observed fixed cohort:
- 4,096 seeds
- 4,096 unique variant IDs
- 4,096 unique genotypes
- 0 genotype collisions
- worst normalized marginal gene entropy: ~0.999326
- maximum relative per-gene deviation from uniform: ~7.96%

Genome v1:
- 199,148,544 theoretical genotype combinations
- idealized uniform combinatorial capacity: ~27.56927 bits

Canonical registry:
- 1 real indexed variant at the observation checkpoint

Interpretation:
- Entropy collapse is NOT OBSERVED in the fixed breeder probe.
- This does not measure external ecosystem entropy or adoption.
- Theoretical genotype count is not implemented population.
